name: CTS Corporation
summary: CTS Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells sensors, connectivity components, and actuators in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers controls, pedals, sensors, switches, transducers, and piezo sensing products; EMI/RFI filters, capacitors, resistors, RF filters, and frequency control products; and piezo microactuators and rotary actuators. In addition, it designs, develops, and manufactures advanced pressure sensing technologies for medical devices, life sciences, and industrial applications.
